# The Prospecting Show
> Business podcast hosted by Dr. Connor Robertson covering sales, marketing, and entrepreneurship.

## About
The Prospecting Show is a business podcast featuring interviews with entrepreneurs, sales leaders, and industry experts. Hosted by Dr. Connor Robertson, the show covers prospecting strategies, business development, marketing, and building successful companies.
